voices.text: In Kurigram, Bangladesh, a seed warning offers forty-eight hours. Upstream runoff and a hundred thirty-eight millimeters of forecast rain threaten low-lying fields. The goal: give farmers time to prepare.
voices.spokenText: In Kurigram, Bangladesh, a seed warning offers forty-eight hours. Upstream runoff and a hundred thirty-eight millimeters of forecast rain threaten low-lying fields. The goal: give farmers time to prepare.
corrections: Identifies alrt_001 as an expired seed scenario, not a current forecast.
Flooding is a risk, not a guaranteed outcome; 138 mm and 48-hour lead time are verified alert text.

voices.text: AgriClimate is one app with two faces and a shared data layer. Farmers get four tabs and a language switch. Officers get a map command center. Same blocks, different decisions.
voices.spokenText: Agri Climate is one app with two faces and a shared data layer. Farmers get four tabs and a language switch. Officers get a map command center. Same blocks, different decisions.
corrections: English is the default; Bengali is supported but not every UI label is translated.
12 blocks, 4,245 farmers and 44 pumps are seed dataset counts, not verified adoption figures.

voices.text: The officer's view has three columns: controls, a MapLibre map, and the selected block's telemetry. Here, Chilmari South's seed data shows a water stress index of zero point seven two, above the warning threshold. Click a field block, and its context comes forward.
voices.spokenText: The officer's view has three columns: controls, a Map Libre map, and the selected block's telemetry. Here, Chilmari South's seed data shows a water stress index of zero point seven two, above the warning threshold. Click a field block, and its context comes forward.
corrections: Calls CWSI 0.72 a seed value, not today's live observation.
Verified accompanying seed values: NDVI 0.42 and LST 33.4 degrees Celsius; threshold is strictly above 0.70.

voices.text: Seven map layers: crop greenness, soil moisture, flood risk, water stress, rain, pump priority, and fire. The legend follows each switch. Four basemaps add context, including satellite imagery. If WebGL is unavailable, an SVG fallback still shows the blocks.
voices.spokenText: Seven map layers: crop greenness, soil moisture, flood risk, water stress, rain, pump priority, and fire. The legend follows each switch. Four basemaps add context, including satellite imagery. If Web G L is unavailable, an S V G fallback still shows the blocks.
corrections: Seven overlays are not seven independently live satellite feeds.
Avoids endorsing inconsistent source-resolution labels and the unverified ten-year baseline.
SVG fallback preserves block visualization, not necessarily full basemap or WebGL feature parity.

voices.text: The fire adapter connects to NASA FIRMS. With a key, it can fetch VIIRS thermal detections from two satellites, score their radiative power, and assign them to monitoring blocks. This is integration code, not proof of today's fires.
voices.spokenText: The fire adapter connects to NASA FIRMS. With a key, it can fetch veers thermal detections from two satellites, score their radiative power, and assign them to monitoring blocks. This is integration code, not proof of today's fires.
corrections: No live NASA POST was performed; no current fire or 52.3 MW observation was verified.
Sources are NOAA-20 and Suomi-NPP VIIRS 375m; block assignment uses coordinate thresholds, not nearest-distance calculation.
A FIRMS key is required; the region remains hardcoded to Kurigram.

voices.text: The officer opens a composer, chooses severity, and adds guidance for this block. Saving places the advisory in the farmer's feed. English and Bengali fields can travel together. Translation is not automatic, and SMS and push remain labels, not delivery services.
voices.spokenText: The officer opens a composer, chooses severity, and adds guidance for this block. Saving places the advisory in the farmer's feed. English and Bengali fields can travel together. Translation is not automatic, and S M S and push remain labels, not delivery services.
corrections: The dispatch API persists JSON; it does not call a telecom or push gateway despite success-message wording.
The composer preserves prefilled Bengali, otherwise may repeat English detail; API fallbacks are generic Bengali.
Same-browser state is updated before API success; do not imply guaranteed server persistence or device delivery.

voices.text: Switch to the farmer's view. Only officer-dispatched advisories for this block, or the district, enter the feed. The language switch reveals supplied Bengali or English text. Advisories load when this view mounts; no delivery time or background polling is promised.
voices.spokenText: Switch to the farmer's view. Only officer-dispatched advisories for this block, or the district, enter the feed. The language switch reveals supplied Bengali or English text. Advisories load when this view mounts; no delivery time or background polling is promised.
corrections: Removed unmeasured ninety-second latency and real-push implication.
Alerts are fetched on mount, while same-browser modes share Zustand state; there is no periodic polling.
Supplied bilingual fields may be shown, but arbitrary English content is not translated.

voices.text: The farmer's home asks: what should I do today? Soil strata make surface and root-zone moisture readable. A pumping dial sits alongside weather and crop-growth visuals. Tap through for more detail. Some displays are illustrative, including the fixed two-hour pumping window; they are not all measured field readings.
voices.spokenText: The farmer's home asks: what should I do today? Soil strata make surface and root-zone moisture readable. A pumping dial sits alongside weather and crop-growth visuals. Tap through for more detail. Some displays are illustrative, including the fixed two-hour pumping window; they are not all measured field readings.
corrections: Actual layout: three decision cards, containing four visual components.
Dial values 17:30–19:30, two hours and 3.2 litres saved are hardcoded, not sourced from the irrigation plan.
Weather and growth visuals include heuristics; seed series have uneven lengths rather than 12 by 30 points.

voices.text: Crop advice is a scoring engine, not a chatbot. Twenty crops are ranked on moisture, temperature, rain, estimated solar energy, and vegetation. For Chilmari South's seed data, mungbean scores ninety-one. Templates explain the strongest factors, flag weaknesses when needed, and estimate a harvest window. No language model required.
voices.spokenText: Crop advice is a scoring engine, not a chatbot. Twenty crops are ranked on moisture, temperature, rain, estimated solar energy, and vegetation. For Chilmari South's seed data, mungbean scores ninety-one. Templates explain the strongest factors, flag weaknesses when needed, and estimate a harvest window. No language model required.
corrections: Verified knowledge-base count is 20, not 21.
Executed actual score engine: seed and current stored Chilmari ranking is Mungbean 91, Groundnut 87, Green Chili 83; not Boro Rice first.
Solar is estimated from temperature; risk notes only appear below a 0.5 subscore; harvest windows are estimates.
The pure scoring calculation needs no network, but this does not establish full-app offline support.

voices.text: Now the pump request loop. The farmer enters a reason and urgency. The API computes deficit severity from the block's available water stress index, scaled to a hundred. The officer reviews the queued request, approves it, and saves a note. Back in the farmer's view, that decision can be retrieved. One shared record connects the request, review, and response.
voices.spokenText: Now the pump request loop. The farmer enters a reason and urgency. The A P I computes deficit severity from the block's available water stress index, scaled to a hundred. The officer reviews the queued request, approves it, and saves a note. Back in the farmer's view, that decision can be retrieved. One shared record connects the request, review, and response.
corrections: Pump severity uses the active DAL metric, not necessarily fresh live telemetry; seed CWSI 0.72 implies 72, but observed runtime data can differ.
Approval is persisted by PATCH with officerNote; this does not mean physical pump deployment.
Farmer and officer retrieval is mount/block-change based and same-browser shared state, not guaranteed instant cross-device delivery.

voices.text: Our irrigation response lists three deficit blocks and forty-four pump assets. Seed moisture data sets priorities and estimated hours. Hourly revalidation is a cache setting, not automatic satellite sync.
voices.spokenText: Our irrigation response lists three deficit blocks and forty-four pump assets. Seed moisture data sets priorities and estimated hours. Hourly revalidation is a cache setting, not automatic satellite sync.
corrections: Actual GET localhost:3457 returned 3 deficit blocks and 44 pumps; deployment severity/hours: Chilmari 84/34, Rajarhat 64/26, Ulipur 32/13.
Scheduler always uses static seed data and illustrative recycled pump IDs, not a capacity-constrained 44-pump routing optimizer.
Threshold is below -2 percentage points; revalidate=3600 is not background hourly sync.

voices.text: NASA POWER uses short timeouts, two retries, and six-hour fetch revalidation. Retry delays grow linearly. Missing temperature days are filtered before charting. Local calculations turn temperature, humidity, and baseline soil moisture into water stress. Forward rain is an estimate, not a separately downloaded forecast.
voices.spokenText: NASA POWER uses short timeouts, two retries, and six-hour fetch revalidation. Retry delays grow linearly. Missing temperature days are filtered before charting. Local calculations turn temperature, humidity, and baseline soil moisture into water stress. Forward rain is an estimate, not a separately downloaded forecast.
corrections: POWER-specific timeout/cache policy is not shared by every external client.
Backoff is linear, not exponential.
Invalid non-temperature fields use fallback values; the CWSI soil term uses baseline moisture, not the daily depletion-model output.
POWER is daily weather/reanalysis; forward rain and some series metrics are local heuristics.

voices.text: Behind both views, the data layer tries stored live records and falls back to seed. Metrics are cached; seed records are validated on first use. This reduces dependence on NASA, without guaranteeing offline browsing, atomic writes, or measured response speeds.
voices.spokenText: Behind both views, the data layer tries stored live records and falls back to seed. Metrics are cached; seed records are validated on first use. This reduces dependence on NASA, without guaranteeing offline browsing, atomic writes, or measured response speeds.
corrections: Both live and hybrid modes fall back; no strict live-only mode exists.
Zod validation is lazy first use, not module load.
File writes are ordinary writeFileSync calls, not atomic replacement; alerts reread files.
Removed unmeasured sub-millisecond and never-blank-screen guarantees; server fallback is not browser offline support.

voices.text: Thirty-four tests pass; two fail on interface text. Both failures remain visible. An offline notice does not mean offline support. Voice query is unfinished: the endpoint returns five-oh-one.
voices.spokenText: Thirty-four tests pass; two fail on interface text. Both failures remain visible. An offline notice does not mean offline support. Voice query is unfinished: the endpoint returns five-oh-one.
corrections: Fresh pnpm test exit 1: 34 passed, 2 failed, 36 total; 8 files passed and 1 failed.
No service worker or full offline shell/tile cache was found.
Voice POST returns HTTP 501; no voice recognition or NLP implementation is claimed.
Colorblind-safe design intent is not presented as a verified accessibility audit.

voices.text: Source is on GitHub. Clone, install, and run; seed data needs no NASA keys. Add a FIRMS key for fire integration. Twelve blocks, twenty crops, two languages: satellite information, translated into field decisions.
voices.spokenText: Source is on GitHub. Clone, install, and run; seed data needs no NASA keys. Add a FIRMS key for fire integration. Twelve blocks, twenty crops, two languages: satellite information, translated into field decisions.
corrections: No LICENSE file or package license field corroborates README's MIT claim; removed MIT/open-source licensing assertion.
Corrected 21 crops to 20 and Bengali-default to two supported languages.
A FIRMS key enables the integration but does not reconfigure hardcoded district geography.
The product is presented as a working prototype, not a measured production deployment.

timingMethod: Actual ffprobe WAV duration. No fabricated word timestamps; scene-level narration only.
processing: Kokoro synthesis; ffmpeg loudnorm I=-18 LUFS, TP=-2 dBTP, LRA=7; mono 48 kHz 16-bit PCM. No atempo or silence padding.
